lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, approximately circular spots arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the pectoral region, transitioning into a more defined grid pattern further back.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased luminance intersect with horizontal alignment of spots, creating a lattice-like structure where the highest intensity pixels are concentrated at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and lower luminance/shadow on the ventral-facing edge.
